limits: This scope is the exact cubeA / enJellyCube / renderer 121012 source assignment only; Cube E, resource prefabs, sibling cube chassis, and topology peers receive no credit from this record.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced health from 58 to 53; death used the explicit KillSingle fixture and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Eighteen selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 342 captured frames and generated videos are retained evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The fixture drives native deathHeavy_jelly while the active renderer and enabled Animator retain m_DoRagdoll false; the authored geometry leaves view by the sampled early death frames, so this establishes animator-driven disappearance and loot handoff rather than a visible corpse, physics ragdoll, renderer teardown, floor contact, or later corpse lifetime.

Per-frame readback records fixed slot 0 and the native slot-1 _MainTex scroller advancing at rate (0, 0.2); selected stills establish two visible authored material regions but do not by themselves establish perceptually continuous scrolling, clone independence, or long-session material lifetime.

The foreground hero, bright impact flare, green particles, UI, and loot depth blur obscure causal hit and death frames; other native attacks, portrait, collision, extended culling, full campaign completion, and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
